description: Find nodes of the matter's graph whose words contain `text` (case-insensitive): list facts and documents by name, claims found in verified documents by their words. Each node has `kind`, `id` and `label`; a claim also names its `documentId` and `runId`. Pass a node's `kind` and `id` to `lists.graph.neighbours.list` to read what it is linked to, or to `lists.graph.paths.list` to follow links further. Ordered by kind (facts, claims, documents), then id; paginated with a cursor.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page to fetch the next page

kind.description: Only nodes of this kind; every kind when left out.

text.description: Words the node's name or text contains.
